annotations.title: Acknowledge or delete many inbox messages

description: Webhook inbox pro: acknowledge (mark read) or delete many messages of an upgraded inbox at once; for one message on any inbox, inbox_ack or inbox_delete. ack takes ids or through and keeps them; delete takes through (that message and every older one, for good). Needs an active pro plan on that inbox (its own item: buy it after your human says yes), else 403 inbox_pro_required.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

through.description: A message id: it and every older one.
